title: Summer money
text: He wants money of his own this summer. There's a farm hiring kids to bring the hay in, a Muay Thai camp abroad where his uncle can get him a job sweeping the ring, or his parents will pay for a fancy sports camp instead.

choices.outcome: Twelve-hour days, blistered hands, and his first real wages.

choices.text: Sweeping the ring at the Thai camp.
choices.outcome: The fighters start letting him join the end of their sessions. By August he can clinch with the young ones.

person.about: Calls him 'little brother' and says to come back any time.

choices.text: The sports camp his parents pay for.
choices.outcome: Good food, good coaches, a bit of everything. He comes home fit and a little spoiled.
